import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(0.01)  # ~1km buffer
years = [2019, 2020, 2021]
rainfall_totals = {}
pixel_counts = {}

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
for year in years:
    start_date = f'{year}-09-01'
    end_date = f'{year}-11-30'
    # Use CHIRPS daily precipitation
    chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(seattle)
    
    # Check collection size
    size = chirps.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        print(f"{year} SON Images: 0")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    
    # Sum daily precipitation, mask no-data (values < 0)
    total_rain = chirps.select('precipitation') \
        .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.gte(0))) \
        .sum()
    
    # Get pixel count and mean rainfall over the region
    stats = total_rain.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(
            ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True
        ),
        geometry=seattle,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    mean_rain = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    count = stats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo()
    
    # Store results
    rainfall_totals[year] = mean_rain
    pixel_counts[year] = count
    
    print(f"{year} SON: Mean Rainfall = {mean_rain:.2f} mm, Valid Pixels = {int(count)}")

# 3. Validation
for year in years:
    if rainfall_totals[year] is None:
        print(f"{year} rainfall value is None")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()
    if pixel_counts[year] == 0:
        print(f"{year} has no valid pixels after masking")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()

# 4. Comparison
rain_2019 = rainfall_totals[2019]
rain_2020 = rainfall_totals[2020]
rain_2021 = rainfall_totals[2021]

if rain_2021 > rain_2020 and rain_2021 > rain_2019:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
